title: Plugin element registry entry (DRAFT)
description: registries/elements/<tag>.yaml. Feeds the tag-to-file registry (wc-registry.json). role block = insertable by authors, needs haxProperties; role injected = page singleton, none needed.

path.description: A module this plugin ships (frontend/dist/...), or a package specifier resolved through the site's import map (@haxtheweb/micro-game-base/lib/concept-quest-game.js) for packs that group elements published elsewhere.

role.description: block: authors insert it (needs haxProperties). injected: the plugin places it in pages itself. admin: loaded into the dashboard (app-hax) or editor chrome, never into page content.

haxProperties.description: Path to the element's *.haxProperties.json, in this plugin or as a package specifier (validated with hax-schema when installed). Required for role block.
